Hello Svitlo student, welcome to my lesson course on cryptography! This page will give you a brief overview of the course content, and an explanations of my teaching method.


Cryptography is all about answering the question *'How do I send secret messages to someone, without anyone else knowing what they mean?'*. Hopefully, by the end of this course, you will be able to send a message to someone where no one else will be able to understand it. That is the goal for the end of the term.

Below shows what we will be learning about in each lesson this term.

I have designed the course so that each lesson builds on the last lesson. Alongside cryptography, you will be learning useful Mathematical techniques which can be used in other areas of Maths (such as prime factor decomposition and Euclids algorithm). I have made this course so that we start with easier Maths, and it will get harder along the way. At the start of each section, I have given it a difficuly ranking. This is done so that if you are struggling with the Maths, then you can skip some of the harder sections, and just focus on the easier ones. However, I think everyone should have a go at the first two lessons.

## Course structure

One of the main problems with the flipped learning classroom appraoch is that it is difficult to get immediate feedback when you are working through the content. To fix this problem, I have created google classroom quizzes for each lesson. Each lesson is split into a few different sections, and each section will have its own google classroom quiz which will be released when at the end of the previous weeks lesson. This means you will have a few chances to test your understanding before the review.
